svg.title: M01 Canal Workshop — proposed coordinate plan
svg.desc: Development diagram of the proposed 120 by 80 meter arena. X increases east; Z increases north. White ground is the union of three six-meter lanes, four four-meter connectors, two bases, tower and core pads, six cell pads and three-meter cell access paths, and nine-meter central combat widenings. Tower collision radius is one meter; core collision radius is two meters. Six opaque non-walkable blockers do not intersect the ground. All positions are from docs/content/02-arena-and-objectives.md, v0.1, 2026-10-21. Diagram verification is not a gameplay or navigation test.

g.text: 3 lanes / 4 links / 12 towers / 2 cores / 6 cells / 6 blockers
Ground includes r = 3 m structure pads, 3 m cell access, and 9 m central combat widths.
Source: docs/content/02-arena-and-objectives.md | Proposed coordinates; diagram QA only, not a navigation test.
